********
NeuroRA2
********
A Python Toolbox of Representational Analysis from Multi-modal Neural Data
**************************************************************************

NeuroRA2 (an updated version of NeuroRA) is an easy-to-use toolbox based on Python, which can do some works about representational similarity analysis (RSA) among nearly all kinds of neural data, including behavioral, EEG, MEG, fNIRS, sEEG, ECoG, fMRI and some other neuroelectrophysiological data. In addition, users can do Inter-Subject Correlation (ISC), Classification-based EEG decoding and a novel cross-temporal RSA (CTRSA) on NeuroRA.

Author: Zitong Lu

.. figure::logo.jpg
